theme_and_archetype.archetype: 1 (Organic & Earthy - with User-defined Vedic Slate override)
theme_and_archetype.description: A uniform dark neutral theme infused with warm 'Sacred Earth' and Vedic colors. The app feels grounding, clinical-yet-spiritual, utilizing dense spacing for deep focus.

typography.heading_strategy: Use Cormorant Garamond for all H1, H2, and H3 elements to enforce the spiritual/Vedic feel. Use tracking-tight.
typography.body_strategy: Use Outfit for all readable content, metrics, UI labels, and inputs for modern, clean humanist legibility.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Mobile-first responsive layout with generous inner padding (p-6, p-8) within cards to create breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style grids for dashboard metrics. Vertical stacks for journal timeline.
spacing_and_layout.borders_and_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for badges and small buttons. Thin 1px borders (border-white/5) to outline cards.

motion_and_interactions.general: Slow, smooth transitions (duration-500) mimicking deep breathing.
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Hover: scale down slightly (scale-95) with opacity-90 to feel grounded rather than 'bouncing'.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade-in with slight upward drift (opacity: 0 -> 1, y: 10 -> 0).

components.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-[#E58A44] text-[#161B22] rounded-full hover:bg-[#E58A44]/90. Secondary: bg-[#21262D] border border-[#30363D] text-[#F0F4F8].
components.cards: bg-[#21262D] rounded-2xl p-6 border border-[#30363D]/50 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)].
components.inputs: bg-[#161B22] border-[#30363D] rounded-xl text-[#F0F4F8] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#E58A44].
components.glassmorphism: Used sparingly on fixed bottom nav or sticky top headers: bg-[#161B22]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#30363D]/50.

iconography.style: Light stroke (stroke-width 1.5), rounded edges, avoiding heavy filled icons.

image_urls.description: Green leafed tree surrounded by fog - perfectly matches the Sage and Slate grounding vibe.
Gray rocks on seashore, symbolic of grounding and foundation for the 5 pillars.
Sunrise mist over trees - aligns with Morning Cortisol visual palette.
Starry dark night sky - aligns with Evening Melatonin visual palette.

screens_blueprint.splash_auth: Full-screen background image (splash_and_auth) with a heavy #161B22/80 gradient overlay. Logo in Cormorant Garamond. Social/Email login buttons stacked at the bottom.
screens_blueprint.onboarding_pillars: Grid layout (cols-1 or cols-2). Each pillar is a card with subtle Sage icon. User selects to unlock 'Goals'.
screens_blueprint.goal_setup: Bento style. 5 AI-suggested goals in selectable list, 1 custom input field. Time-estimate slider (days/hours).
screens_blueprint.dashboard: Top: Bless Points balance & Veda Streak counter in a prominent Saffron-accented widget. Middle: Daily Mini-Tasks checklist (auto-generated from goals). Bottom: Fab or large button to enter Journal.
screens_blueprint.journal_flow: Distraction-free 5-step horizontal swipe or vertical scroll sequence. 1. Situation (Text) -> 2. Emotion (Tags) -> 3. NLP Frame (Select 1 of 5) -> 4. Ease Slider (1-10) -> 5. End Feeling. Evening entries include a 'Bless Point' gratitude prompt.
screens_blueprint.journal_history: Vertical timeline of past entries. Date-wise. Cards use #21262D background.
screens_blueprint.hpa_axis_premium: The crown jewel. Dynamic UI. Reads local time. If 5AM-2PM: Cortisol AM palette and images. If 5PM-4AM: Melatonin PM palette and images. Uses rich gradients transitioning the background color seamlessly.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Tailwind CSS is configured with the exact hex codes provided in color_system.
Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Import Cormorant Garamond and Outfit via Google Fonts.
Implement the HPA Axis theme dynamically using React state and standard JS Date object to toggle Tailwind classes or CSS variables.
Use Shadcn UI for standard elements (sliders, inputs) but strip default Vercel-look borders and apply the rounded-2xl and custom #30363D borders.
Every interactive element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
The application is mobile-first. Use max-w-md mx-auto on large screens to simulate a mobile app container, or keep it beautifully responsive.
